bio: Located in Dallas's Lower Greenville district, Rye sports a sexy, cozy vibe with wood plank floors, beamed ceiling, and exposed red brick walls. Guests are cared for with a genuine hospitality and the beverage selection is especially impressive with a range of cocktails on offer (they also operate Apothecary, the cocktail lounge next door).Food-wise, the cuisine is unrestrained and offers diners a taste of wide-ranging inspirations. The à la carte menu serves up the likes of a Texas-raised wagyu beef hot dog or a dish of comforting cacio e pepe. The tasting menu is an extensive affair that may combine a beef tallow and mezcal emulsion drizzled taco, a slice of beet and goat cheese lasagna, and chocolate cake dressed with spruce and rosemary....
